description: FD-29 minimal capability baseline for the main window. Grants only event emission/listening, webview default APIs, and (added in v0.4.0 Phase 1, F-901) the four narrow core:window permissions the custom titlebar's window-caption buttons need over decorations:false: allow-minimize, allow-toggle-maximize, allow-close, allow-start-dragging. Deliberately NOT core:window:default, which is much broader (monitor/cursor queries, resizability, visibility, etc.) than this window ever calls; only the exact commands src/components/shell/WindowControls.tsx and Titlebar.tsx's drag region invoke are allowed. Explicitly still NO fs, NO shell, NO dialog. Folder access is mediated by the backend from v0.4.0 (F-909, tauri-plugin-dialog); the frontend never touches the filesystem directly.
